label: PF Backlog 96
title: Backend: review/feedback ledger - producer agent, artifact, reviewer, feedback, resolution status
body:
Track every review/feedback as a first-class record: producer agent, artifact (+ item_id/feature_id), reviewer (human/agent), feedback text, resolution status (open|partial|resolved|rejected), linked change/BI, timestamps. FOLD into the existing core/cross_review.py store (cross-reviews.json) - single writer, do NOT create a new store; add resolution/status + links; expose via API (GET/POST /api/v1/reviews).

[OWNER DECISION 2026-09-22] SPEC-REVIEW LOOP (GATE BEFORE IMPLEMENTATION).
validate/QA MUST REVIEW EACH functional spec AND design spec per feature, RECORD the feedback in
this ledger, and LOOP BACK to fix; this review GATES implementation (no implementation before the
per-feature specs are reviewed and resolved).

decisions.note: Spec-review loop: validate/QA reviews each functional + design spec per feature, records feedback, loops back before implementation
